title: Aloo Gobi
description: Potatoes and cauliflower cooked with cumin, turmeric, ginger and tomato until tender and golden. A dry curry that’s vegan.

image.alt: A bowl of turmeric potatoes and cauliflower with cilantro

steps.text: Heat the oil in the skillet over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for {time 30 sec}, then cook the onion until soft, {time 5 min}.
Add the ginger and garlic for {time 1 min}, then the turmeric, coriander and cayenne for {time 30 sec}.

Add the potatoes, cauliflower and salt and toss until everything is coated in the spices. Add {qty 1/4 cup} water, cover and cook over medium-low heat, stirring now and then, until the potatoes are nearly tender, {time 15 min}.
Add the tomato, uncover and cook, turning gently, until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned in places, {time 8-10 min}.
Sprinkle with the garam masala and cilantro and serve with flatbread or rice and dal.

notes: Stir gently so the cauliflower keeps its shape.
